newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grincor forms logistics division.
newsitem.headline: Grincor forms logistics division.

text.p: Shipping group Grincor announced on Wednesday it had formed a new logistics division, Grincor Logistics (Pty) Ltd, to co-ordinate its supply chain management.

"Each individual segment of the supply chain will be handled by a 'second tier' of suppliers -- a group of subcontracted road-hauliers, terminal and warehousing companies, and air, sea and rail operators," the company said in a statement.
Grincor Logistics would co-ordinate these sub-contracted divisions, it said.
It added that the division had been created to integrate the marketing efforts of the group's various operational divisions and to implement value added supply chain solutions for clients.
